all: DataTables internal responsive layout marker; does not require custom presentation.
container: Bootstrap responsive container for fixed max-width grid layout; sizing handled by Bootstrap grid.
container-fluid: Bootstrap fluid container for full-width grid layout; sizing handled by Bootstrap grid.
content: Layout wrapper for main content area; sizing and spacing handled by parent container.
content-page: Layout wrapper for FAP page shell; inherits flex container layout.
dataTable: Base behavioral hook for DataTables library; styled via table classes.
dropdown-wrapper: Structural DOM wrapper generated by Select2 to encapsulate dropdown options.
dt-responsive: DataTables responsive behavior marker class enabling responsive row toggling.
dtr-inline: Layout mode class for responsive DataTables child row toggle mechanism.
end-0: Bootstrap layout positioning utility pinning element to the right edge.
even: Zebra striping helper class for alternating rows; handled by table rules.
fade: Bootstrap transition state class coordinating element opacity fade animations.
header-title: Typography wrapper for card headers; inherits card font and text styling.
input: Behavioral base class added by third-party flatpickr; styles come from form-control.
lh-sm: Bootstrap line-height typography utility setting line-height to small (1.25).
list-inline-item: Bootstrap list layout utility setting display to inline-block for inline lists.
logo-dark: Hyper template brand logo container toggled natively by FAP theme stylesheets.
logo-light: Hyper template brand logo container toggled natively by FAP theme stylesheets.
min-w-0: Bootstrap flexbox sizing utility setting min-width to zero to prevent overflow.
nav-justified: Bootstrap navigation layout utility expanding nav items equally across width.
no-footer: DataTables layout status class indicating absence of footer element.
nowrap: White-space utility handled natively by Bootstrap or parent table formatting.
odd: Zebra striping helper class for alternating rows; handled by table rules.
opacity-50: Bootstrap display utility setting element opacity to fifty percent.
password-eye: Hyper template toggle indicator hook for showing or hiding password text.
position-absolute: Bootstrap positioning utility setting element position to absolute.
select2-hidden-accessible: Accessibility class hiding original select element offscreen for screenreaders.
selection: Structural wrapper generated by Select2 DOM; styled through component parts.
show: Bootstrap visibility state class indicating active tab or shown dropdown element.
small: Bootstrap typography utility class or HTML tag reducing font size to 87.5 percent.
tab-content: Bootstrap tab container coordinating active pane visibility via tab panels.
tab-pane: Bootstrap tab content panel toggling visibility based on active tab state.
top-0: Bootstrap layout positioning utility pinning element to the top edge.
visually-hidden: Bootstrap accessibility utility hiding element visually while keeping it screenreader accessible.
